Yen Surges Against Dollar Amid Shifting Rate Bets and Intervention Warnings

The Japanese yen experienced a significant surge, gaining approximately 2.4% against the dollar over the week, marking its best performance since July. This appreciation occurred amidst mixed signals regarding the U.S. Federal Reserve's future interest rate decisions, which kept traders uncertain ahead of a key inflation report. Japan's Finance Minister, Satsuki Katayama, is reportedly under pressure to strengthen the yen while navigating demands from domestic officials and Washington. The Japanese government has issued warnings against a weak yen and stated its readiness to intervene in currency markets to manage its value. The dollar posted a weekly loss as these developments unfolded across global currency markets.
